Shopping through our links supports Rescued Treasures Pet Adoptions. Meet our rescue ↗

A few good questions.

How do I order?

Open a category and follow its shopping link. Our partners handle checkout and orders; Shop RTPA does not take payments. Cookie ordering details will be posted when ready.

How does shopping help RTPA?

Amazon apparel earns RTPA a royalty. Qualifying Litter-Robot referrals earn the rescue store credit. Other partners have their own arrangements, explained with each offering. Merchandise purchases are not direct donations.

What about shipping and pickup?

Each partner shows its prices, delivery costs, and policies at checkout. Class Dismissed cookies are baked to order for local pickup only in Webster, NY, with no shipping fees.

Do I need a special link?

Use the RTPA shopping link shown with each partner so your purchase can support the rescue. For order questions, contact the partner shown on your confirmation.

Rescue Favorites

Litter-Robot · Used & loved by our rescue

Less scooping. More time for cats.

We use Litter-Robots in our rescue and recommend them from firsthand experience. Automatic cleaning helps us keep up with litter-box chores, leaving more time for the animals in our care.

Save $50 and help our rescue. When an eligible new customer buys a qualifying new Litter-Robot through our referral link, RTPA receives $100 in Whisker store credit toward equipment and supplies.

Shop Litter-Robot & save $50 ↗

Referral offer subject to Whisker’s current eligibility and terms. Reconditioned units and subscriptions are excluded. Whisker handles checkout, shipping, and support. RTPA receives store credit, not cash.
